title: Secret key ops: CreateObject, Encrypt, Decrypt, Digest, HMAC
description: Implement CKO_SECRET_KEY creation and all symmetric crypto operations needed for Ciphers/SecretKeyTest, HmacTest, and DigestTest suites. Currently 132 tests fail. This covers: C_CreateObject(CKO_SECRET_KEY), C_EncryptInit/Encrypt/Update/Final, C_DecryptInit/Decrypt/Update/Final for AES-ECB/CBC and DES-ECB/CBC and 3DES-ECB/CBC, C_DigestInit/Digest/Update/Final for MD5/SHA/SHA256/SHA384/SHA512, C_SignInit/Sign and C_VerifyInit/Verify for HMAC mechanisms.
